console.log('Processing in Travel Info node');
const travel = $node["Code"].json;
console.log('Travel Info departureLocation:', travel.departureLocation);

// Generate a detailed itinerary similar to the email
let itinerary = `# 🌴 Tropical Beach Getaway to ${travel.destination} Itinerary 🌺

` +
  `**Travel Dates:** ${travel.startDate} - ${travel.endDate}
` +
  `**Departure Location:** ${travel.departureLocation}
` +
  `**Destination:** ${travel.destination}
` +
  `**Group Size:** ${travel.groupSize}
` +
  `**Budget:** $${travel.budget}

` +
  `---

` +
  `## ✈️ Flights

` +
  `**Recommended Airlines:**
` +
  `1. **American Airlines**: ORD to HNL (Honolulu International). One-stop layover in Los Angeles (LAX) or Dallas (DFW).
` +
  `2. **United Airlines**: ORD to HNL, typically with a layover in San Francisco (SFO) or Los Angeles (LAX).
` +
  `3. **Delta Airlines**: ORD to HNL, with a layover in Seattle (SEA).

` +
  `### Estimated Flight Duration:
` +
  `- **Approx. 10-12 hours:** Including layover time.

` +
  `### Booking Tips:
` +
  `- Book tickets 2-3 months in advance for better rates.
` +
  `- Check aggregators like [Google Flights](https://www.google.com/flights) or [Kayak](https://www.kayak.com/) for the best deals.

` +
  `---

` +
  `## 🏨 Accommodation Options

` +
  `### Maui:
` +
  `1. **Marriott's Maui Ocean Club**
` +
  `   - 🏖 Beachfront property with great amenities.
` +
  `   - [Book Here](https://www.marriott.com/hotels/travel/oggmv-marriotts-maui-ocean-club-napili-towers/)

` +
  `2. **Wailea Beach Resort**
` +
  `   - 🌺 Luxurious stay with ocean views and a fantastic pool.
` +
  `   - [Book Here](https://www.marriott.com/hotels/travel/oggwv-wailea-beach-resort-marriott-ml/)

` +
  `### Oahu:
` +
  `1. **Hilton Hawaiian Village Beach Resort & Spa**
` +
  `   - 🌴 Unique village atmosphere with multiple pools and restaurants.
` +
  `   - [Book Here](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/hnlhhhv-hilton-hawaiian-village-beach-resort-and-spa/)

` +
  `2. **Moana Surfrider, A Westin Resort & Spa**
` +
  `   - 🏝 Historic hotel right on the beach in Waikiki.
` +
  `   - [Book Here](https://www.marriott.com/hotels/travel/hnlwi-moana-surfrider-a-westin-resort-and-spa-waikiki-beach/)

` +
  `---

` +
  `## 🗓 Daily Itinerary

` +
  `### Day 1: Arrival in Honolulu (July 1)
` +
  `- **Morning**: Flight from ORD to HNL.
` +
  `- **Afternoon**: Check-in at hotel.
` +
  `- **Evening**: Dinner at **Duke's Waikiki**.
` +
  `  - 🍽 [Reservation](https://www.dukeswaikiki.com/)

` +
  `### Day 2: Beach Relaxation & Nightlife (July 2)
` +
  `- **Morning**: Relax at Waikiki Beach 🌊.
` +
  `- **Afternoon**: Lunch at **Hula Grill**.
` +
  `  - 🍽 [Lunch Menu](https://www.hulagrillwaikiki.com/)
` +
  `- **Evening**: Check out local nightlife at **The Republik**.
` +
  `  - 🎶 [Event Schedule](https://www.republikhi.com/)

` +
  `### Day 3: Snorkeling Adventure (July 3)
` +
  `- **Morning**: Book a **snorkeling tour to Hanauma Bay**.
` +
  `  - 🏄‍♂️ [Tour Info](https://www.hanaumabaynaturepreserve.com/)
` +
  `- **Evening**: Dinner at **Azure Restaurant**.
` +
  `  - 🍽 [Menu](https://www.azurewaikiki.com/)

` +
  `### Day 4: Maui Excursion (July 4)
` +
  `- **Morning**: Take a flight to Maui (~30 mins).
` +
  `- **Afternoon**: Rent a car & head to **Maui Ocean Center**.
` +
  `  - 🐠 [Visit Here](https://mauioceancenter.com/)
` +
  `- **Evening**: Beach bonfire at your resort. 🔥

` +
  `### Day 5: Adventure Sports & Relaxation (July 5)
` +
  `- **Morning**: Go zip-lining or take a helicopter tour of the island.
` +
  `  - 🚁 [Helicopter Tour Booking](https://www.mauihelicopters.com/)
` +
  `- **Evening**: Dinner at **Mama's Fish House**.
` +
  `  - 🍽 [Reservation](https://www.mamasfishhouse.com/)

` +
  `### Day 6: Beach Day and Local Events (July 6)
` +
  `- **Morning**: Spend a relaxing morning at Kaanapali Beach 🏖.
` +
  `- **Afternoon**: Visit the **Whalers Village Shopping Mall**.
` +
  `- **Evening**: Attend a Luau at **Royal Lahaina Resort**.
` +
  `  - 🍽 [Luau Info](https://www.royallahainaluau.com/)

` +
  `### Day 7: Leisure & Fine Dining (July 7)
` +
  `- **Morning**: Spa day at your resort. 🌅
` +
  `- **Afternoon**: Enjoy lunch at **Leilani's on the Beach.**
` +
  `  - 🍽 [Lunch Spot](https://www.leilanis.com/)
` +
  `- **Evening**: Farewell dinner at **Merriman's Kapalua**; enjoy sunset views.
` +
  `  - 🍽 [Reservation](https://merrimanshawaii.com/)

` +
  `### Day 8: Departure (July 8)
` +
  `- **Morning**: Last breakfast in Hawaii at **The Gazebo.**
` +
  `  - 🍽 [Menu](https://thegazebo.com/)
` +
  `- **Afternoon**: Return to HNL and catch your flight back to ORD.

` +
  `---

` +
  `## 🚗 Transportation and Travel Tips

` +
  `### Transportation:
` +
  `- **Car Rental**: Recommended for Maui to explore the island. Check [Kayak](https://www.kayak.com/cars) for competitive rates.
` +
  `- **Public Transport**: Use TheBus on Oahu for affordable transport.
` +
  `- **Rideshare**: Uber and Lyft are available on both islands for convenience.

` +
  `### Travel Tips:
` +
  `- **Stay Hydrated**: The Hawaiian sun can be strong, so drink plenty of water.
` +
  `- **Sunscreen**: Use reef-safe sunscreen to protect marine life.
` +
  `- **Local Culture**: Respect local customs, and consider attending a hula demonstration or community event.
` +
  `- **Time Zone**: Hawaii is -2 hours from PST, be mindful of jet lag!

` +
  `Embrace the tropical paradise! 🌺 You’re in for a wonderful adventure!
` +
  `Generated by Voyage Genie ✨
`;

return [{
  json: {
    destination: travel.destination,
    departureLocation: travel.departureLocation,
    startDate: travel.startDate,
    endDate: travel.endDate,
    groupSize: travel.groupSize,
    budget: travel.budget,
    tripType: travel.tripType,
    ageRange: travel.ageRange,
    dayActivity: travel.dayActivity,
    nightActivity: travel.nightActivity,
    email: travel.email,
    itinerary: itinerary
  }
}];
